summary: Post-market brief: composite risk 50.56, the caution band, regime goldilocks and confidence 0.9167. The score was effectively unchanged, a trend of -0.04, while the internals split: 19 of the 22 sectors and themes closed higher, AI Software leading at 2.2866 and FinTech the weakest at -1.0018, yet cross-asset confirmation reads only 0.5 with 4 of the 8 production signals triggered. The discount-rate block still binds at 70.63 on a 2026-09-28 vintage that carries the ten-year at 5.24 and the real rate at 2.9, both in the 100.0th percentile, and the policy path stays priced for easing at 3.747 against an effective fed funds rate of 3.88 even as the two-year rose to 4.92. Breadth improved but remains inverted, 3 new highs against 19 new lows of 156 names. The tracked A-share panel closed all 11 names lower in its final session before the XSHG holiday, which runs from 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-07.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation is the largest single contribution at 7.5 but reads only 0.5: the dollar is 120.33, the real rate 2.9 and small-cap relative -9.562, so 4 of the 8 production signals are triggered.

The discount-rate constraint is still the heaviest block at 70.63: the ten-year is 5.24 from 5.17 and the real rate 2.9 from 2.83, both in the 100.0th percentile, making macro the largest single contribution to a 50.56 composite.

The curve bear-flattened: the ten-year at 5.24 against the two-year at 4.92 leaves the 10Y/2Y spread at 0.32, from 0.36, and in the 60.35th percentile, so the front end is repricing alongside the long end.
Equity structure stayed inverted: 3 new highs against 19 new lows of 156 names, breadth above the 200-day average at 0.5742, and semis relative at -7.624.

The policy path and the front end now disagree: FedWatch implies 3.747 with action cut against an effective fed funds rate of 3.88, while the two-year rose 0.11 to 4.92 and Governor Cook said inflation has been too high for too long.

supporting_signals.claim: Participation broadened: 19 of the 22 sectors and themes closed higher, led by AI Software at 2.2866, Enterprise Software at 1.4731 and Cybersecurity at 1.471.
Leadership rotated from hardware to software: memory added 1.1212 and semiconductor equipment 1.1861, while AI infrastructure managed only 0.3974 against AI Software at 2.2866.
Breadth improved but stays inverted: above the 200-day average is 0.5742 with 89 of 155 names, the new-highs ratio is 0.0192, and semis relative is -7.624.
The tracked mega-caps advanced: NVDA added 1.5954 to 230.835007, AMD 0.9077 and MU 0.477, while AVGO slipped 0.383.
Volatility stayed contained: the VIX is 16.04 in the 32.7th percentile and realized volatility 10.816 with a risk score of 13.26, leaving the block at 23.63.

contradicting_signals.claim: The tape and the cross-asset block diverged: 19 of the 22 sectors and themes closed higher, yet confirmation reads only 0.5 as the dollar at 120.33, the real rate at 2.9 and small-cap relative at -9.562 all keep triggering.
The rates block sits on a 2026-09-28 vintage, so the ten-year at 5.24 and the real rate at 2.9 predate the two most recent sessions and part of the block's calm may be a vintage artefact.
The front end and the policy path disagree: the two-year rose 0.11 to 4.92 while FedWatch moved to an easing bias at 3.747 against an effective fed funds rate of 3.88.
Breadth remains inverted despite the rally: 3 new highs against 19 new lows of 156 names, with only 0.5742 of the panel above its 200-day average.
Credit widened a second layer: HY OAS moved to 3.08 from 3.02 and IG OAS to 0.84 from 0.83 while the equity tape rose.

what_changed_today: The composite held at 50.56 with a trend of -0.04, and the caution band and the goldilocks regime were both unchanged.
Leadership rotated out of hardware: AI Software led at 2.2866 and Enterprise Software at 1.4731, while Data Centers fell 0.4773 and FinTech 1.0018.
Cross-asset confirmation is 0.5 with 4 of the 8 production signals triggered, the layer's largest single contribution at 7.5.
The curve bear-flattened to 0.32 as the ten-year rose to 5.24 from 5.17 while the two-year rose to 4.92 from 4.81 and the real rate to 2.9 from 2.83.
Credit widened with the equity tape up: HY OAS to 3.08 from 3.02 and IG OAS to 0.84 from 0.83.
The volatility vintage advanced one session to a 2026-09-29 observation: the VIX at 16.04 from 16.07, still short of the fact layer's own 2026-09-30 timestamp.
The reverse repo facility rose to 11.539 from 11.446 on a same-day 2026-09-30 vintage.
The tracked A-share panel closed all 11 names lower, 002156.sz the worst at -5.7323, in its final session before the XSHG holiday from 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-07.

The Employment Situation release at 2026-10-02, against payrolls of 162.0 on a 2026-08 vintage and unemployment at 4.1.
Whether the rates series advances past the 2026-09-28 observation, since the ten-year at 5.24 predates the two most recent sessions.

Whether the A-share de-rating transmits into the US AI hardware complex while the CN leg cannot confirm: XSHG is shut from 2026-10-01 through 2026-10-07 and reopens 2026-10-08.

bull_case.title: Bull case: earnings carry the tape past the discount rate
points: Participation is broad rather than narrow: 19 of the 22 sectors and themes closed higher with AI Software at 2.2866 and Enterprise Software at 1.4731 leading.
Volatility is contained: the VIX is 16.04 in the 32.7th percentile and realized volatility 10.816 scores only 13.26.
The trend block still supports the tape: price sits 6.4923 above its 200-day average with three-month momentum at 2.7616.

base_case.title: Base case: the discount rate caps the rally without breaking it
points: The constraint is persistent: the ten-year at 5.24 and the real rate at 2.9 both sit in the 100.0th percentile and macro is the heaviest block at 70.63.
The composite is 50.56 with a trend of -0.04, so the tape is absorbing the rate level without repricing risk.
Internals stay weak but not deteriorating: breadth above the 200-day average at 0.5742, with 3 new highs and 19 new lows of 156 names.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the front end breaks the easing pricing
points: The front end is rising into an easing-priced path: the two-year at 4.92 against a 0.32 curve, with the real rate at 2.9 leaving little room for a dovish repricing.
Credit is widening: HY OAS at 3.08 from 3.02 and IG OAS at 0.84 from 0.83.
The tracked A-share panel closed all 11 names lower, the worst at -5.7323, and the CN leg cannot confirm until 2026-10-08.
